extraction_method: PyMuPDF page.get_text('dict') text spans; whole-word match against Team2 opening allowlist (SD|DW1|DW2); dimensions are Team2 library defaults pending per-drawing dimension extraction.
notes: Position values are PDF-point center coordinates of the LABEL TEXT (not the opening centre on the wall). Position tolerance is generous (500mm) because architectural callouts are positionally fuzzy. Width/height are Team2 library defaults pending Karthik confirmation of per-drawing dimensions. Iteration 2 (PR 4 calibration): tolerance widened from 500mm to 1000mm — labels float up to ~30pt (≈530mm at 1:50) above wall axis, so 500mm was systematically excluding correct detections; 1000mm absorbs typical label-to-wall projection offset.
